# testdata/catalogs

Catalog directories for tests, each in the `--catalog <dir>` layout (`catalog.yaml` and `profiles/`).

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| [e2e/](e2e/) | `jq` and `gh`, profiles `e2e`, `other`, `tools` (fake-brew end-to-end tests) |
| [integration/](integration/) | GNU `hello`, profile `integration` (real-Homebrew integration test, I1-14) |

Back to [testdata](../README.md).
